title: NVIDIA and KAIST Launch Joint AI Research Lab to Accelerate AI Innovation in Korea
summary: NVIDIA and the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) today announced the launch of a joint AI research laboratory at the KAIST Kim Jaechul Graduate School of AI in Seoul, dedicated to advancing agentic AI for South Korea.
